title: Structure a Seedance 2.5 travel-vlog prompt by explicitly defining Environment…
content:
Structure a Seedance 2.5 travel-vlog prompt by explicitly defining Environment, Visual style, Camera language, Subject styling, Core performance, and Negative prompts before writing the shot list.

Maintain realism by specifying an authentic handheld phone-vlog texture for most shots, then add a few smoother establishing drone/gimbal wide shots for variety.

Keep multi-location continuity by assigning each location a distinct lighting signature (e.g., Seville warm golden tones, Gaztelugatxe windswept coastal light, Girona cool stone-and-shadow/dusk tones) and reinforcing it throughout the prompt.

Control pacing like a real vlog by prompting quick walking transitions, jump cuts, and short travel-montage inserts (train window/car dashboard/road sign) between locations.

Improve character consistency by describing the host’s age range, outfit, props, and framing (late 20s–30s, t-shirt/cap/backpack/sunglasses, selfie-style with phone extended).

Direct performance across scenes by specifying emotional beats that evolve over time (excited → physically tired but thrilled → calmer reflective).

Use negative prompts to prevent unwanted artifacts and IP leakage: no subtitles/on-screen text, no distorted hands/faces, no show/franchise/character names, no logos, and no reproduced dialogue from the source material.

Add realism by prompting ambient location sound (footsteps, wind, distant chatter, ocean waves) and explicitly requesting no background music score.

Write the video as a timestamped shot list with shot types and actions (selfie walk-in, garden pan, staircase climb, wide landscape, alley walk, final selfie) to control composition and progression.

es.content:
Estructura un prompt de travel-vlog para Seedance 2.5 definiendo explícitamente Environment, Visual style, Camera language, Subject styling, Core performance y Negative prompts antes de escribir la shot list.

Mantén el realismo especificando una textura auténtica de phone-vlog en handheld para la mayoría de los planos, y luego añade unos pocos planos generales más suaves de establecimiento con drone/gimbal para aportar variedad.

Mantén la continuidad entre varias localizaciones asignando a cada lugar una firma de iluminación distinta (por ejemplo, tonos dorados cálidos en Sevilla, luz costera azotada por el viento en Gaztelugatxe, tonos fríos de piedra y sombra/atardecer en Girona) y reforzándola a lo largo de todo el prompt.

Controla el ritmo como si fuera un vlog real, pidiendo transiciones rápidas caminando, jump cuts e inserciones breves de travel-montage (ventana de tren, salpicadero de coche, señal de carretera) entre localizaciones.

Mejora la consistencia del personaje describiendo el rango de edad del host, el outfit, los props y el encuadre (finales de los 20 a 30 y pocos, camiseta/gorra/mochila/gafas de sol, estilo selfie con el teléfono extendido).

Dirige la interpretación en todas las escenas especificando beats emocionales que evolucionen con el tiempo (entusiasmado → físicamente cansado pero emocionado → más calmado y reflexivo).

Usa negative prompts para evitar artefactos no deseados y filtraciones de IP: sin subtítulos/texto en pantalla, sin manos/caras distorsionadas, sin nombres de series/franquicias/personajes, sin logos y sin diálogos reproducidos del material de origen.

Añade realismo pidiendo sonido ambiente de la localización (pasos, viento, murmullo lejano, olas del mar) y solicitando explícitamente que no haya música de fondo.

Escribe el video como una shot list con marcas de tiempo, tipos de plano y acciones (selfie walk-in, garden pan, staircase climb, wide landscape, alley walk, final selfie) para controlar la composición y la progresión.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Thread 1] Environment: Tres localizaciones reales de España a lo largo de un viaje de varios días: los ornamentados patios moriscos y los arcos de azulejos del Real Alcázar en Sevilla, la espectacular escalera/puente de piedra serpenteante junto al acantilado de San Juan de Gaztelugatxe en la costa vasca, y las estrechas calles medievales de piedra del casco antiguo y el Barrio Judío de Girona.

Visual style: Travel-vlog realista, brillante, cálido y de alta energía. Tonos dorados cálidos en Sevilla, luz costera dramática y azotada por el viento en Gaztelugatxe, tonos fríos de piedra y sombra en los callejones de Girona. Textura auténtica de handheld "phone vlog" mezclada con unos pocos planos de establecimiento más suaves con drone/gimbal.

Camera language: Principalmente planos handheld estilo selfie con el host hablando a cámara, combinados con amplios planos generales de establecimiento en cada localización. Transiciones rápidas caminando y jump cuts típicos del ritmo de un travel-vlog real.

Subject styling: Un hombre de finales de los 20 a los 30 y pocos, outfit casual de viaje, camiseta, gorra, mochila, gafas de sol, enérgico, con el teléfono/cámara de vlogging extendido delante de él.

Core performance: Entusiasmo genuino de fan que va en aumento en cada parada, físicamente cansado por la escalera pero aún emocionado, más tranquilo y reflexivo al llegar a los callejones de Girona.

Negative prompts: Sin subtítulos/texto en pantalla, sin manos/caras distorsionadas, sin nombres de series, nombres de personajes, títulos de franquicias, logos ni diálogos reproducidos en ninguna parte; esto es un travel vlog del mundo real sobre monumentos españoles reales, descritos solo por sus nombres y apariencia reales.

[00-04] Plano selfie: entra caminando en el patio de azulejos del Real Alcázar en Sevilla, sonriendo, con la cámara paneando para mostrar los arcos y el estanque reflectante.

Dialogue: "Okay, stop number one, Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I'm here."

[04-08] Plano caminando por los jardines del palacio, paneando sobre las fuentes y los azulejos.

Dialogue: "I've seen this courtyard on screen so many times and it still doesn't compare to standing here in person."

[08-11] Jump cut de travel-montage rápido: ventana de tren, salpicadero de coche, señal de carretera, el tiempo y la ubicación avanzando, desembocando en un plano general costero dramático del islote de Gaztelugatxe y su puente de piedra serpenteante.

Dialogue: "Fast forward a few hours north, this is the one I've been waiting for."

[11-15] Empieza a subir la escalera de piedra serpenteante, el viento sopla con fuerza, el océano rompe abajo a ambos lados, respirando un poco más agitado mientras asciende.

Dialogue: "This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah, if this scenery looks familiar from a certain dragon-themed show, that's exactly why I'm here."

[15-19] Plano general desde más arriba de la escalera, las olas rompiendo de forma espectacular contra los acantilados de abajo, él pequeño en el encuadre frente al enorme paisaje.

Dialogue: "Okay, this view. Worth every single one of those steps."

[19-22] Transición rápida de travel-montage otra vez, coche, carretera, atardecer, desembocando en un callejón estrecho de piedra en el casco antiguo de Girona, con luz cálida de la tarde.

Dialogue: "Last stop, and honestly one of my favorites, Girona."

[22-26] Plano caminando por las estrechas y sinuosas calles de piedra del Barrio Judío, con la cámara paneando hacia arriba para mostrar los altos edificios de piedra muy juntos.

Dialogue: "These alleys were used for some of the most memorable chase scenes in the show. It's even narrower in person than it looks on screen."

[26-30] Plano final selfie, de pie en el callejón mientras la luz del atardecer golpea los muros de piedra, ahora más calmado y reflexivo.

Dialogue: "Three cities, three completely different corners of Spain, all real, all still here. Let me know which location you want to see me visit next."

Reforzar a lo largo de todo: cada localización mantiene su firma de iluminación distintiva, Sevilla dorada cálida, Gaztelugatxe costera azotada por el viento, Girona con atardecer cálido sobre la piedra, textura auténtica de handheld vlog consistente en las tres, sonido ambiente de la localización presente en todo momento, pasos, viento, murmullo lejano, olas del mar en Gaztelugatxe, sin subtítulos, sin música de fondo, diálogo interpretado con un ritmo natural y enérgico de vlogger durante todo el video.

fr.content:
Structurez un prompt de travel-vlog pour Seedance 2.5 en définissant explicitement l’Environnement, le style visuel, le langage caméra, le stylisme du sujet, la performance principale et les negative prompts avant d’écrire la shot list.

Conservez le réalisme en spécifiant une texture authentique de phone-vlog handheld pour la plupart des plans, puis ajoutez quelques plans larges d’établissement plus fluides en drone/gimbal pour varier.

Assurez la continuité multi-lieux en attribuant à chaque lieu une signature lumineuse distincte (par exemple, tons dorés chauds à Séville, lumière côtière balayée par le vent à Gaztelugatxe, tons froids de pierre et d’ombre / crépuscule à Gérone) et en la renforçant tout au long du prompt.

Contrôlez le rythme comme un vrai vlog en demandant des transitions de marche rapides, des jump cuts et de courts inserts de travel-montage (fenêtre de train / tableau de bord de voiture / panneau routier) entre les lieux.

Améliorez la cohérence du personnage en décrivant la tranche d’âge, la tenue, les accessoires et le cadrage de l’hôte (fin de vingtaine–trentaine, t-shirt / casquette / sac à dos / lunettes de soleil, style selfie avec le téléphone tendu).

Dirigez la performance d’une scène à l’autre en précisant des beats émotionnels qui évoluent au fil du temps (excité → physiquement fatigué mais ravi → plus calme et contemplatif).

Utilisez des negative prompts pour empêcher les artefacts indésirables et les fuites de propriété intellectuelle : pas de sous-titres / texte à l’écran, pas de mains / visages déformés, pas de noms de séries / franchises / personnages, pas de logos, et pas de dialogue reproduit à partir du matériau source.

Ajoutez du réalisme en demandant un son ambiant de lieu (pas, vent, conversations lointaines, vagues de l’océan) et en exigeant explicitement l’absence de musique de fond.

Écrivez la vidéo sous forme de shot list horodatée avec types de plans et actions (selfie walk-in, garden pan, staircase climb, wide landscape, alley walk, final selfie) pour contrôler la composition et la progression.

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---
[Thread 1] Environnement : Trois lieux réels en Espagne au cours d’un voyage de plusieurs jours : les cours mauresques ornées et les arches carrelées du Real Alcázar à Séville, l’escalier / pont de pierre spectaculaire et sinueux à flanc de falaise de San Juan de Gaztelugatxe sur la côte basque, et les étroites rues médiévales en pierre de la vieille ville de Gérone et du quartier juif.

Style visuel : Réalisme de travel-vlog lumineux, chaleureux et énergique. Tons dorés chauds à Séville, lumière côtière dramatique balayée par le vent à Gaztelugatxe, tons froids de pierre et d’ombre dans les ruelles de Gérone. Texture authentique de « phone vlog » handheld mêlée à quelques plans d’établissement plus fluides en drone/gimbal.

Langage caméra : Principalement des plans handheld en selfie, avec l’hôte parlant à la caméra, mêlés à de larges plans d’établissement panoramiques dans chaque lieu. Transitions de marche rapides et jump cuts typiques du rythme d’un vrai travel-vlog.

Stylisme du sujet : Un homme dans la fin de la vingtaine ou la trentaine, tenue de voyage décontractée, t-shirt, casquette, sac à dos, lunettes de soleil, énergique, téléphone / caméra de vlog tendu devant lui.

Performance principale : Enthousiasme sincère de fan qui monte à chaque étape, physiquement fatigué par l’escalier mais toujours ravi, plus calme et réfléchi dans les ruelles de Gérone.

Negative prompts : Pas de sous-titres / texte à l’écran, pas de mains / visages déformés, pas de noms de séries, noms de personnages, titres de franchises, logos, ni de dialogue reproduit nulle part ; il s’agit d’un travel vlog réel sur de vrais monuments espagnols, décrits uniquement par leurs vrais noms et leur apparence.

[00-04] Plan selfie : il entre à pied dans la cour carrelée du Real Alcázar à Séville, souriant, la caméra se déplaçant pour montrer les arches et le bassin réfléchissant.

Dialogue : "Okay, stop number one, Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I'm here."

[04-08] Plan en marchant à travers les jardins du palais, panoramique sur les fontaines et les mosaïques.

Dialogue : "I've seen this courtyard on screen so many times and it still doesn't compare to standing here in person."

[08-11] Jump cut de travel-montage rapide : fenêtre de train, tableau de bord de voiture, panneau routier, le temps et la localisation qui défilent, puis arrivée sur un plan large côtier spectaculaire de l’îlot de Gaztelugatxe et de son pont de pierre sinueux.

Dialogue : "Fast forward a few hours north, this is the one I've been waiting for."

[11-15] Il commence à monter l’escalier de pierre en colimaçon, le vent souffle fort, l’océan se fracasse en contrebas des deux côtés, il respire un peu plus lourdement en grimpant.

Dialogue : "This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah, if this scenery looks familiar from a certain dragon-themed show, that's exactly why I'm here."

[15-19] Plan large depuis plus haut dans l’escalier, les vagues s’écrasant de façon spectaculaire contre les falaises en contrebas, lui petit dans le cadre face à l’immense paysage.

Dialogue : "Okay, this view. Worth every single one of those steps."

[19-22] Nouvelle transition rapide de travel-montage : voiture, route, coucher de soleil, puis arrivée dans une ruelle étroite en pierre de la vieille ville de Gérone, lumière chaude de fin de journée.

Dialogue : "Last stop, and honestly one of my favorites, Girona."

[22-26] Plan en marchant dans les étroites rues sinueuses en pierre du quartier juif, la caméra remontant vers les hauts bâtiments de pierre serrés les uns contre les autres.

Dialogue : "These alleys were used for some of the most memorable chase scenes in the show. It's even narrower in person than it looks on screen."

[26-30] Plan selfie final, debout dans la ruelle tandis que la lumière du soir frappe les murs de pierre, plus calme et plus contemplatif maintenant.

Dialogue : "Three cities, three completely different corners of Spain, all real, all still here. Let me know which location you want to see me visit next."

À renforcer tout au long : chaque lieu conserve sa signature lumineuse distincte, Séville doré, Gaztelugatxe côtier balayé par le vent, Gérone crépuscule chaud sur la pierre, texture authentique de vlog handheld cohérente sur les trois lieux, son ambiant présent en continu, pas à pas, vent, conversations lointaines, vagues de l’océan à Gaztelugatxe, pas de sous-titres, pas de musique de fond, dialogue livré tout au long avec un débit naturel et énergique de vlogger.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 の travel-vlog プロンプトは、ショットリストを書く前に、Environment、Visual style、Camera language、Subject styling、Core performance、Negative prompts を明示的に定義して構成する。

ほとんどのショットでは、リアルな手持ちのスマホ vlog らしい質感を指定してリアリズムを保ち、そのうえでバリエーションとして、より滑らかな establishing の drone/gimbal の wide shot をいくつか加える。

複数ロケーションの一貫性は、各場所に固有のライティング・シグネチャーを割り当てることで維持する（例: Seville の暖かいゴールデントーン、Gaztelugatxe の風にさらされた海岸光、Girona の冷たい石と影／夕暮れトーン）。そして、それをプロンプト全体で繰り返し強調する。

実際の vlog のようなテンポを出すために、場所の切り替えの間には、素早い歩きのトランジション、jump cut、短い travel-montage の挿入（train window / car dashboard / road sign）を促す。

キャラクターの一貫性を高めるには、ホストの年齢層、服装、小道具、フレーミングを具体的に描写する（late 20s–30s、t-shirt/cap/backpack/sunglasses、phone を前に伸ばした selfie-style）。

シーンをまたいだ演技は、時間とともに変化する感情のビートを指定して直接コントロールする（excited → physically tired but thrilled → calmer reflective）。

Negative prompts では、不要なアーティファクトや IP 漏えいを防ぐ: no subtitles/on-screen text, no distorted hands/faces, no show/franchise/character names, no logos, and no reproduced dialogue from the source material.

さらにリアリズムを高めるため、ambient なロケーション音（footsteps, wind, distant chatter, ocean waves）を指定し、background music score は入れないよう明示的に要求する。

動画は、構図と進行をコントロールするために、shot types と actions を含む timestamped shot list として書く（selfie walk-in, garden pan, staircase climb, wide landscape, alley walk, final selfie）。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Environment: Three real Spanish locations across a multi-day trip, the ornate Moorish courtyards and tiled arches of the Real Alcázar in Seville, the dramatic cliffside winding stone staircase/bridge of San Juan de Gaztelugatxe on the Basque coast, and the narrow medieval stone streets of Girona's old town and Jewish Quarter.

Visual style: Bright, warm, high-energy travel-vlog realism. Warm golden tones in Seville, dramatic wind-swept coastal light at Gaztelugatxe, cool stone-and-shadow tones in Girona's alleys. Authentic handheld "phone vlog" texture mixed with a few smoother establishing drone/gimbal shots.

Camera language: Mostly selfie-style handheld shots with the host talking to camera, mixed with sweeping wide establishing shots at each location. Quick walking transitions and jump cuts typical of real travel-vlog pacing.

Subject styling: A man in his late 20s to 30s, casual travel outfit, t-shirt, cap, backpack, sunglasses, energetic, phone/vlogging camera extended in front of him.

Core performance: Genuine fan excitement escalating at each stop, physically tired by the staircase but still thrilled, quieter and more reflective by the Girona alleys.

Negative prompts: No subtitles/on-screen text, no distorted hands/faces, no show names, character names, franchise titles, logos, or dialogue reproduced anywhere, this is a real-world travel vlog about real Spanish landmarks, described only by their real names and appearance.

[00-04] Selfie shot: he walks into the Real Alcázar's tiled courtyard in Seville, grinning, camera panning to show the arches and reflecting pool.

Dialogue: "Okay, stop number one, Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I'm here."

[04-08] Walking shot through the palace gardens, panning across fountains and tilework.

Dialogue: "I've seen this courtyard on screen so many times and it still doesn't compare to standing here in person."

[08-11] Quick travel-montage jump cut: a train window, a car dashboard, a road sign, time and location passing, landing on a dramatic coastal wide shot of Gaztelugatxe's islet and winding stone bridge.

Dialogue: "Fast forward a few hours north, this is the one I've been waiting for."

[11-15] He starts up the winding stone staircase, wind blowing hard, ocean crashing below on both sides, breathing a little heavier as he climbs.

Dialogue: "This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah, if this scenery looks familiar from a certain dragon-themed show, that's exactly why I'm here."

[15-19] Wide shot from higher up the staircase, waves crashing dramatically against the cliffs below, him small in frame against the huge landscape.

Dialogue: "Okay, this view. Worth every single one of those steps."

[19-22] Quick travel-montage transition again, car, road, sunset, landing on a narrow stone alley in Girona's old town, warm evening light.

Dialogue: "Last stop, and honestly one of my favorites, Girona."

[22-26] Walking shot through the narrow winding stone streets of the Jewish Quarter, camera panning up at the tall stone buildings pressing close together.

Dialogue: "These alleys were used for some of the most memorable chase scenes in the show. It's even narrower in person than it looks on screen."

[26-30] Final selfie shot, standing in the alley as evening light hits the stone walls, calmer and more reflective now.

Dialogue: "Three cities, three completely different corners of Spain, all real, all still here. Let me know which location you want to see me visit next."

全体を通して強調する点: 各ロケーションはそれぞれ固有のライティング・シグネチャーを保つこと。Seville は golden、Gaztelugatxe は windswept coastal、Girona は warm stone dusk。3つすべてで authentic handheld vlog の質感を一貫させること。ambient なロケーション音を全編に入れること。footsteps, wind, distant chatter, Gaztelugatxe では ocean waves。no subtitles, no background music score。dialogue は全体を通して自然でエネルギッシュな vlogger の口調で話すこと。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5 여행 브이로그 프롬프트를 구성할 때는, 샷 리스트를 쓰기 전에 Environment, Visual style, Camera language, Subject styling, Core performance, Negative prompts를 명시적으로 정의하세요.

대부분의 샷에서는 실제 핸드헬드 폰 브이로그 특유의 질감을 유지하고, 다양성을 위해 몇 개의 더 부드러운 establishing drone/gimbal wide shot을 추가해 현실감을 살리세요.

여러 장소가 이어지는 흐름에서는 각 로케이션마다 고유한 조명 시그니처를 부여해 연속성을 유지하세요(예: 세비야의 따뜻한 골든 톤, 가스텔루가체의 바람에 휩쓸린 해안광, 지로나의 차갑고 그늘진 석조/황혼 톤). 그리고 이를 프롬프트 전반에 걸쳐 일관되게 강화하세요.

실제 브이로그처럼 템포를 조절하려면, 장소 사이에 빠른 도보 전환, jump cut, 짧은 여행 몽타주 삽입물(기차 창문/차량 대시보드/도로 표지판)을 넣도록 프롬프트하세요.

호스트의 나이대, 의상, 소품, 프레이밍(20대 후반~30대, 티셔츠/캡/백팩/선글라스, 휴대폰을 앞으로 뻗은 셀피 스타일)을 묘사해 캐릭터 일관성을 높이세요.

장면별 감정의 흐름이 시간에 따라 변화하도록(흥분 → 육체적으로 지쳤지만 여전히 감격 → 더 차분하고 성찰적인 분위기) 직접적으로 퍼포먼스를 지정하세요.

원치 않는 아티팩트와 IP 유출을 막기 위해 negative prompts를 사용하세요: 자막/화면 텍스트 없음, 왜곡된 손/얼굴 없음, 쇼/프랜차이즈/캐릭터 이름 없음, 로고 없음, 원본 소재의 대사 재현 없음.

현장감을 더하려면 주변 환경음(발걸음, 바람, 멀리서 들리는 사람들 소리, 파도 소리)을 프롬프트하고, 배경음악은 없도록 명시적으로 요청하세요.

비디오를 timestamp가 포함된 shot list로 작성하고, shot type과 action(selfie walk-in, garden pan, staircase climb, wide landscape, alley walk, final selfie)을 함께 적어 구도와 진행을 제어하세요.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Environment: 세비야의 Real Alcázar에 있는 화려한 무어 양식의 안뜰과 타일 아치, 바스크 해안의 San Juan de Gaztelugatxe에 있는 극적인 절벽 옆 구불구불한 돌계단/다리, 그리고 지로나 구시가지와 유대인 지구의 좁고 중세적인 석조 거리 등, 며칠에 걸친 여행 속 스페인의 실제 세 곳.

Visual style: 밝고 따뜻하며 에너지가 높은 여행 브이로그 리얼리즘. 세비야의 따뜻한 골든 톤, Gaztelugatxe의 바람에 휩쓸린 극적인 해안광, 지로나 골목의 차갑고 그늘진 석조 톤. 진짜 핸드헬드 “phone vlog” 질감에 몇 개의 더 부드러운 establishing drone/gimbal shot을 섞은 스타일.

Camera language: 주로 호스트가 카메라에 말하는 셀피 스타일의 핸드헬드 샷을 사용하고, 각 장소마다 넓게 펼쳐지는 establishing wide shot을 섞습니다. 실제 여행 브이로그 특유의 빠른 도보 전환과 jump cut을 활용하세요.

Subject styling: 20대 후반~30대의 남성, 캐주얼한 여행 복장, 티셔츠, 캡, 백팩, 선글라스, 에너지가 넘치며 휴대폰/브이로그 카메라를 앞으로 뻗고 있음.

Core performance: 각 장소마다 진짜 팬의 흥분이 점점 고조되고, 계단에서는 육체적으로 지쳤지만 여전히 감격하며, 지로나 골목에서는 더 조용하고 성찰적인 분위기로 변함.

Negative prompts: 자막/화면 텍스트 없음, 왜곡된 손/얼굴 없음, 쇼 이름, 캐릭터 이름, 프랜차이즈 제목, 로고, 또는 어디에서도 재현된 대사 없음. 이는 실제 스페인의 랜드마크를 다루는 현실 세계 여행 브이로그이며, 실제 이름과 외형으로만 묘사합니다.

[00-04] Selfie shot: 그는 세비야의 Real Alcázar 타일 안뜰로 걸어 들어오며 미소 짓고, 카메라가 아치와 반사 수영장을 보여주도록 팬합니다.

Dialogue: "Okay, stop number one, Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I'm here."

[04-08] 궁전 정원을 걸으며 분수와 타일 장식을 따라 카메라가 팬하는 샷.

Dialogue: "I've seen this courtyard on screen so many times and it still doesn't compare to standing here in person."

[08-11] 빠른 여행 몽타주 jump cut: 기차 창문, 차 대시보드, 도로 표지판, 시간과 장소가 지나가며, Gaztelugatxe의 섬과 구불구불한 돌다리가 보이는 극적인 해안 wide shot으로 전환.

Dialogue: "Fast forward a few hours north, this is the one I've been waiting for."

[11-15] 그는 구불구불한 돌계단을 오르기 시작하고, 강한 바람이 불며, 양쪽 아래로 바다가 거세게 부딪치고, 오르면서 숨이 조금 더 가빠집니다.

Dialogue: "This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah, if this scenery looks familiar from a certain dragon-themed show, that's exactly why I'm here."

[15-19] 계단 위쪽에서 찍은 wide shot, 아래 절벽에 파도가 극적으로 부딪치고, 거대한 풍경 속에서 그는 작게 보입니다.

Dialogue: "Okay, this view. Worth every single one of those steps."

[19-22] 다시 한 번 빠른 여행 몽타주 전환, 차, 도로, 석양이 이어지고, 지로나 구시가지의 좁은 석조 골목으로 도착하며 따뜻한 저녁빛이 비칩니다.

Dialogue: "Last stop, and honestly one of my favorites, Girona."

[22-26] 유대인 지구의 좁고 구불구불한 석조 거리를 걸으며, 높은 석조 건물들이 서로 바짝 붙어 있는 모습을 카메라가 위로 팬합니다.

Dialogue: "These alleys were used for some of the most memorable chase scenes in the show. It's even narrower in person than it looks on screen."

[26-30] 마지막 셀피 샷, 저녁빛이 석조 벽을 비추는 골목에 서 있으며, 이제는 더 차분하고 성찰적인 분위기입니다.

Dialogue: "Three cities, three completely different corners of Spain, all real, all still here. Let me know which location you want to see me visit next."

전체적으로 강화할 점: 각 장소는 고유한 조명 시그니처를 유지해야 합니다. 세비야는 골든 톤, Gaztelugatxe는 바람에 휩쓸린 해안광, 지로나는 따뜻한 석조 황혼 톤. 세 곳 모두에서 authentic handheld vlog 질감을 일관되게 유지하고, ambient location sound를 전반에 걸쳐 포함하세요. 발걸음 소리, 바람, 멀리서 들리는 사람들 소리, Gaztelugatxe의 파도 소리. 자막 없음, 배경음악 없음, 대사는 내추럴하고 에너지 있는 브이로거 톤으로 전달됩니다.

pt.content:
Estruture um prompt de travel-vlog para o Seedance 2.5 definindo explicitamente Environment, Visual style, Camera language, Subject styling, Core performance e Negative prompts antes de escrever a shot list.

Mantenha o realismo especificando uma textura autêntica de phone-vlog handheld para a maioria dos takes, e depois adicione alguns wide shots de establishing mais suaves com drone/gimbal para variar.

Mantenha a continuidade entre múltiplas locações atribuindo a cada lugar uma assinatura de luz distinta (por exemplo, tons dourados quentes em Sevilha, luz costeira varrida pelo vento em Gaztelugatxe, tons frios de pedra e sombra/entardecer em Girona) e reforçando isso ao longo de todo o prompt.

Controle o ritmo como um vlog real pedindo transições rápidas caminhando, jump cuts e inserts curtos de travel montage (janela de trem/painel do carro/placa de estrada) entre os locais.

Melhore a consistência do personagem descrevendo a faixa etária do host, roupa, acessórios e enquadramento (fim dos 20 aos 30 e poucos, camiseta/boné/mochila/óculos de sol, estilo selfie com o celular estendido).

Direcione a performance entre as cenas especificando batidas emocionais que evoluem ao longo do tempo (animado → fisicamente cansado, mas empolgado → mais calmo e reflexivo).

Use negative prompts para evitar artefatos indesejados e vazamento de IP: sem legendas/texto na tela, sem mãos/rostos distorcidos, sem nomes de séries/franquias/personagens, sem logos e sem diálogo reproduzido do material de origem.

Adicione realismo pedindo som ambiente da locação (passos, vento, conversa distante, ondas do mar) e solicitando explicitamente sem trilha musical de fundo.

Escreva o vídeo como uma shot list com timestamp, tipos de plano e ações (selfie walk-in, garden pan, staircase climb, wide landscape, alley walk, final selfie) para controlar composição e progressão.

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DO THREAD ---
[Thread 1] Environment: Três locações reais na Espanha ao longo de uma viagem de vários dias: os pátios mouriscos ornamentados e os arcos azulejados do Real Alcázar em Sevilha, a dramática escadaria/ponte de pedra sinuosa à beira do penhasco de San Juan de Gaztelugatxe na costa basca, e as ruas estreitas de pedra medieval do centro histórico e do Bairro Judeu de Girona.

Visual style: Travel-vlog realista, brilhante, quente e de alta energia. Tons dourados quentes em Sevilha, luz costeira dramática e varrida pelo vento em Gaztelugatxe, tons frios de pedra e sombra em Girona. Textura autêntica de "phone vlog" handheld misturada com alguns establishing shots mais suaves de drone/gimbal.

Camera language: Principalmente takes handheld em estilo selfie com o host falando para a câmera, misturados com wide establishing shots amplos em cada locação. Transições rápidas caminhando e jump cuts típicos do ritmo de um travel-vlog real.

Subject styling: Um homem no fim dos 20 aos 30 e poucos anos, roupa casual de viagem, camiseta, boné, mochila, óculos de sol, energético, com o celular/câmera de vlog estendido à frente.

Core performance: Empolgação genuína de fã crescendo a cada parada, fisicamente cansado na escadaria, mas ainda empolgado, mais quieto e reflexivo nas vielas de Girona.

Negative prompts: Sem legendas/texto na tela, sem mãos/rostos distorcidos, sem nomes de séries, nomes de personagens, títulos de franquias, logos ou diálogo reproduzido em qualquer lugar; este é um travel vlog do mundo real sobre marcos espanhóis reais, descritos apenas por seus nomes e aparência reais.

[00-04] Selfie shot: ele entra caminhando no pátio azulejado do Real Alcázar em Sevilha, sorrindo, com a câmera fazendo pan para mostrar os arcos e o espelho d’água.

Dialogue: "Okay, stop number one, Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I'm here."

[04-08] Walking shot pelos jardins do palácio, com pan sobre fontes e azulejaria.

Dialogue: "I've seen this courtyard on screen so many times and it still doesn't compare to standing here in person."

[08-11] Quick travel-montage jump cut: uma janela de trem, o painel de um carro, uma placa de estrada, tempo e localização passando, chegando a um wide shot dramático da ilhota de Gaztelugatxe e da ponte de pedra sinuosa.

Dialogue: "Fast forward a few hours north, this is the one I've been waiting for."

[11-15] Ele começa a subir a escadaria de pedra sinuosa, o vento soprando forte, o oceano quebrando abaixo dos dois lados, respirando um pouco mais pesado enquanto sobe.

Dialogue: "This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah, if this scenery looks familiar from a certain dragon-themed show, that's exactly why I'm here."

[15-19] Wide shot de um ponto mais alto da escadaria, ondas quebrando dramaticamente contra os penhascos abaixo, ele pequeno no quadro contra a paisagem enorme.

Dialogue: "Okay, this view. Worth every single one of those steps."

[19-22] Transição rápida de travel-montage novamente, carro, estrada, pôr do sol, chegando a uma viela estreita de pedra no centro histórico de Girona, luz quente do fim de tarde.

Dialogue: "Last stop, and honestly one of my favorites, Girona."

[22-26] Walking shot pelas ruas estreitas e sinuosas de pedra do Bairro Judeu, câmera fazendo pan para cima nos prédios altos de pedra apertados uns contra os outros.

Dialogue: "These alleys were used for some of the most memorable chase scenes in the show. It's even narrower in person than it looks on screen."

[26-30] Final selfie shot, em pé na viela enquanto a luz do entardecer bate nas paredes de pedra, agora mais calmo e reflexivo.

Dialogue: "Three cities, three completely different corners of Spain, all real, all still here. Let me know which location you want to see me visit next."

Reforce ao longo de todo o vídeo: cada local mantém sua assinatura de luz distinta — Sevilha dourada, Gaztelugatxe costeira varrida pelo vento, Girona com entardecer quente sobre a pedra —, textura autêntica de handheld vlog consistente nas três locações, som ambiente presente o tempo todo, passos, vento, conversa distante, ondas do mar em Gaztelugatxe, sem legendas, sem trilha musical de fundo, diálogo entregue em uma cadência natural e energética de vlogger ao longo de todo o vídeo.

zh.content:
在编写镜头列表之前，先通过明确界定 Environment、Visual style、Camera language、Subject styling、Core performance 和 Negative prompts，来构建一个 Seedance 2.5 旅行 vlog prompt。

通过为大多数镜头指定真实的手持手机 vlog 质感来保持写实感，然后再加入少量更平滑的开场航拍 / gimbal 广角镜头，以增加变化。

通过为每个地点分配独特的光线特征来保持多地点连续性（例如，塞维利亚的温暖金色调、Gaztelugatxe 的风吹海岸光、赫罗纳的冷石墙与阴影 / 黄昏色调），并在整个 prompt 中持续强化。

像真实 vlog 一样控制节奏：在地点之间加入快速步行过渡、jump cuts，以及简短的旅行蒙太奇插入镜头（火车窗、车内仪表盘、路牌）。

通过描述主角的年龄范围、服装、道具和构图方式来提升角色一致性（20 多岁末到 30 多岁、T 恤 / 帽子 / 背包 / 墨镜、手机前伸的自拍式拍法）。

通过指定会随时间推进的情绪节拍来跨场景引导表演（兴奋 → 身体疲惫但依然激动 → 更平静、带有反思感）。

使用 negative prompts 来防止不想要的瑕疵和 IP 泄露：不要字幕 / 屏幕文字、不要变形的手 / 脸、不要节目 / 系列 / 角色名称、不要 logo，也不要复现源材料中的对白。

通过加入环境音来增强真实感（脚步声、风声、远处人声、海浪声），并明确要求不要背景音乐配乐。

将视频写成带时间戳的镜头列表，包含 shot types 和动作（selfie walk-in、garden pan、staircase climb、wide landscape、alley walk、final selfie），以控制构图和推进节奏。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Environment: 西班牙三个真实地点，跨越多日行程，分别是塞维利亚 Real Alcázar 华丽的摩尔式庭院与瓷砖拱廊、巴斯克海岸 San Juan de Gaztelugatxe 戏剧性的悬崖蜿蜒石阶 / 石桥，以及赫罗纳老城区和犹太区狭窄的中世纪石板街道。

Visual style: 明亮、温暖、高能量的 travel-vlog 写实风格。塞维利亚是温暖金色调，Gaztelugatxe 是戏剧性的迎风海岸光，赫罗纳小巷则是冷石墙与阴影色调。真实的手持“phone vlog”质感，混合少量更平滑的开场 drone / gimbal 镜头。

Camera language: 主要是自拍式手持镜头，主角对着镜头说话，辅以每个地点的开阔广角建立镜头。快速步行过渡和 jump cuts，符合真实 travel-vlog 的节奏。

Subject styling: 一名 20 多岁末到 30 多岁初的男性，休闲旅行穿搭，T 恤、帽子、背包、墨镜，充满活力，手机 / vlog 摄像机伸在前方。

Core performance: 真切的粉丝式兴奋感在每一站逐步升级，爬楼梯时身体已经疲惫但仍然激动，到了赫罗纳小巷则更安静、更有反思感。

Negative prompts: 不要字幕 / 屏幕文字，不要变形的手 / 脸，不要节目名、角色名、系列标题、logo，也不要在任何地方复现对白；这是一个关于真实西班牙地标的现实世界旅行 vlog，只能用它们的真实名称和外观来描述。

[00-04] Selfie shot: 他走进塞维利亚 Real Alcázar 的瓷砖庭院，咧嘴笑着，镜头平移展示拱廊和倒影池。

Dialogue: "Okay, stop number one, Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I'm here."

[04-08] Walking shot through the palace gardens, panning across fountains and tilework.

Dialogue: "I've seen this courtyard on screen so many times and it still doesn't compare to standing here in person."

[08-11] Quick travel-montage jump cut: a train window, a car dashboard, a road sign, time and location passing, landing on a dramatic coastal wide shot of Gaztelugatxe's islet and winding stone bridge.

Dialogue: "Fast forward a few hours north, this is the one I've been waiting for."

[11-15] He starts up the winding stone staircase, wind blowing hard, ocean crashing below on both sides, breathing a little heavier as he climbs.

Dialogue: "This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah, if this scenery looks familiar from a certain dragon-themed show, that's exactly why I'm here."

[15-19] Wide shot from higher up the staircase, waves crashing dramatically against the cliffs below, him small in frame against the huge landscape.

Dialogue: "Okay, this view. Worth every single one of those steps."

[19-22] Quick travel-montage transition again, car, road, sunset, landing on a narrow stone alley in Girona's old town, warm evening light.

Dialogue: "Last stop, and honestly one of my favorites, Girona."

[22-26] Walking shot through the narrow winding stone streets of the Jewish Quarter, camera panning up at the tall stone buildings pressing close together.

Dialogue: "These alleys were used for some of the most memorable chase scenes in the show. It's even narrower in person than it looks on screen."

[26-30] Final selfie shot, standing in the alley as evening light hits the stone walls, calmer and more reflective now.

Dialogue: "Three cities, three completely different corners of Spain, all real, all still here. Let me know which location you want to see me visit next."

Throughout the entire piece, reinforce: each location keeps its distinct lighting signature, Seville golden, Gaztelugatxe windswept coastal, Girona warm stone dusk, authentic handheld vlog texture consistent across all three, ambient location sound present throughout, footsteps, wind, distant chatter, ocean waves at Gaztelugatxe, no subtitles, no background music score, dialogue delivered in a natural energetic vlogger cadence throughout.
